title: Which car saves more fuel?
hook: Which mileage upgrade saves more fuel over the same distance?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Compute fuel saved per distance rather than comparing miles-per-gallon differences.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Compute fuel saved per distance rather than comparing miles-per-gallon differences.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: Over 100 miles, a car improves from 10 to 20 mpg. How many gallons are saved? Toy inputs A=[10, 20]; B=[20, 30].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[10, 5, 5], [5, 3.3333333333333335, 1.6666666666666665]]. Labels: Old gal, New gal, Saved gal.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Fuel consumed is distance divided by miles per gallon. The same increase in mpg saves different amounts of fuel at different starting efficiencies. The denominators in the picture expose that nonlinearity.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Old mpg=20, New mpg=30. What is Saved gal? Answer: 1.667.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Old mpg=20, New mpg=30. What is Saved gal?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 1.667. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: People misjudge fuel savings in miles per gallon; gallons per 100 miles fixes the illusion (Larrick & Soll, 2008).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Compute fuel saved per distance rather than comparing miles-per-gallon differences.
